text: Absolutely love this place! Some of the best I've ever had, not just from our server Tiffany who was phenomenal, but from anyone who walked by. Everyone is so friendly and happy. The food is great too.

Stumbled across this restaurant after a late check in at the Kimpton.   It was recommended as a great place to grab a sandwich and beer (appreciated they recommended something other than just the hotel bar).  Very professional servers, a beer menu that is other worldly, and eclectic food menu that has something for everyone.   I would also imagine with the number of TVs it would be a great place to catch a game on the weekends.   Will visit again.

UPDATE 10/30/26 - Stopped by around 11:30 and they were already busy. We were seated in a reasonable time and our server, Tiffany, arrived shortly. The food was great as always except there's unique dipping sauce paired with the Cuban. Interesting... We enjoyed the food tremendously and Tiffany took great care of us. She knew the menu, always there but not too much, engaging personality and an absolute pleasure to talk with. By the time we left, the restaurant was packed and were in overdrive. Sedona is always busy but the servers are always on top of their game! 100 Stars to Tiffany!!! Thank you

Usually always busy but always great. Indoor and outdoor seating; days with nice weather, the area near the bar opens onto the patio. In the cooler months there's usually a heat source outside. Large beer selection and a diverse food menu. Parking is tight, lot for Shops at Millmont could be larger... Servers are very knowledgeable, friendly, and professional. Wait times vary but it's worth it. Lunch and dinner menus - dinner menu has more main course items. We've dined at the Charlottesville and Chesterfield locations and have been pleased with both. This is a great place to meet after work, have lunch, or a special occasion.

The Charlottesville location is amazing!! Led by a Manager/Host named Troy, that cares about each and every customer by checking on them personally. Simply a great location with an amazing staff! The food is amazing as well...the flat iron steak is always a top choice and the quality is outstanding!! Brunch is always great, their drink choices are abundant and the desserts are killer!! I want to say Thank you to all of the staff for always providing a friendly and happy experience.
Food was good, service was good, out server Bri was so nice

We had a WONDERFUL lunch with dear friends!
There is a large variety of menu items and our server (Maria) is the BEST!

We tried to dine in. Today was beautiful day. They refused to sit us outside ( even though others were sat out there with open tables no wait)  heard the server say Im not taking tables outside. Corine the so called  manger allowed this behavior to happen. When I asked to talk to another manager she replied " Im the only manager you need to speak too". Will never attempt to watch at this location again. Very disappointed.  The restaurant was not busy. It was 3 pm in the afternoon.

We used to be regulars but stopped going when it became clear that there is a culture of sexual harassment and condescension from many of the male employees to the female employees. If even a customer can pick up on the sexual harassment and just weird vibes between staff, then you know behind closed doors it is likely really out of hand.
Busted when in town for a vacation . Handled a group of 20 easily.

Vincent our waiter was so kind and very professional. We loved to speak with him. Great food, filet mignon was delicious and salmon (we asked plain for a illness) was soft. We loved the picture of Antelope Canyon and Mesa Arch (reminded us of our beloved west 🇺🇸). We highly recommend to eat here.
Was a excellent.  On our Honeymoon and they made us feel special.
Great meal here with server Matt Handy before seeing Weird Al. Thanks!!
Outstanding dining experience from start to finish. Great food, great service, and Matt, our server choreographed it all with charm, conviviality, and perfectly poised professionalism.

From the moment Mackenzie led us to our table, to Evan taking care of our drinks and meal, Hollan checking us out, and Troy spending time with us , we loved Sedona! It’s not often you go out to eat and join staff happily singing along with the background music! It was such a fun joyous dining experience Wednesday night!
Good food. Great service. Huge beer selection. Good for a casual lunch. Indoors is very NOISY. I always sit outside.
We really enjoyed the food and especially our server, Tiffany. Folks are always friendly and the food is yummy.

Five stars past fantastic! Our server Kevin met every challenge on top of being courteous, efficient, outgoing and, there when needed. Consider asking for Kevin as your server. Food was A+. We wanted a satisfying meal after driving 420 miles, and not having eaten all day. Boom. We got it - I the shrimp alfredo, she, the prime rib sandwich, and a shared Cesare Salad. All perfect. Lively place, rustic-industrial atmosphere. A gazillion crafted beer and ale choices. Bon apetite!
Food was good and service fast.
Tiffany was great!! 😊
Tiffany was awesome
Tiffany was amazing and the food is always delicious
Great brewery restaurant with vegan options!
Excellent restaurant. We eat here whenever we visit Charlottesville. Large menu and excellent beer selections.
Great food and service even for a non-beer drinker. Sunday brunch options are great and fairly priced.
Good pub grub and beers.
Food was excellent and was the service!  My burger was amazing

Went to dinner tonight and it was really good. The service was excellent. My only recommendation would be to ask to be seated near the front of the house, we were seated in the back next to the dish washing station which was less than ideal. But overall it was a great experience and I'll be sure to visit again in the future.

We had a reservation at 8 with a party 15+, majority of the party was a little late due to transportation issues, however as soon as we came in, we were immediately attended to which i’m so grateful for. Our lovely server Vincent was so efficient and such a pleasure having him as he expertly took all of our orders with no mistakes. Shout out to the cooks for making such a phenomenal meal in a quick manner. I would love to come back again!

Today (June 28, 2026), I ordered biscuits and sausage gravy with two scrambled eggs from the brunch menu. The gravy and biscuits were delicious as well as the eggs (really how can you mess up scrambled eggs?). I ate half of the meal bringing the other half home for a later meal. The wait staff was friendly and helpful, and the restaurant was clean. The music was not loud nor were conversations from other patrons. I recommend this restaurant for good food and pleasant atmosphere.

I came with a group of 15+ people and our service was AMAZING. Our reservation was for 8 pm and the food came out extremely fast and the servers were all amazing (especially Vincent!). The food was amazing as well. Will be coming back again.

we came in as a group of 18, we were very satisfied with our meal and server! vincent was very kind and patient with us. the bathrooms are also very very clean!!! thank you for being so patient with us! food was super good! will come back!
This is my favorite restaurant! It's always a 10/10, highly recommend!

Great.  Their food was very good, exceeded expectations.  Service and atmosphere did, as well.  Also nice to note that they cater to higher end consumers AND thrifty customers via their menu options.  I went thrifty and everything was excellent.  Recommend for everybody wanting a nice sitdown dining experience with drinks.
Omg the food eas amazing  like always...I really enjoyed it

★★★★★

We had such a great experience at Sedona Taphouse! The food was delicious, the atmosphere was great, and the service really made the night. Everything came out fresh and was exactly what we were looking for.

We were celebrating a special occasion, and the staff made us feel welcomed and taken care of from the moment we arrived. Definitely a great spot for a night out, and somewhere I’d happily come back to again.

Highly recommend Sedona Taphouse if you’re looking for good food, a fun atmosphere, and great service!
Very good!

🍽️ Dinner at Sedona Taphouse – Charlottesville, VA
We decided to make a meal out of starters at Sedona Taphouse, and everything we ordered was absolutely delicious! Each dish was full of flavor and made for a really enjoyable dinner.

One of the things that really stands out is their incredible beer selection — with over 250 beers, there’s something for just about every beer lover. 🍺

And if you’re looking for something beyond beer, I would highly recommend trying one of their martinis. 🍸 They’re definitely worth ordering!
This was by far the best atmosphere i I have ever been to.  The food was extraordinary delicious and the dessert was breathtaking,  and enough for 2 to share.  Thank you all so very much
Food was great.  Prices reasonable.  Server had too many tables so we had to wait long periods of time when we needed something (like water or dessert)
Great food at a great price will definitely be back
We were traveling from Mrytle Beach to Pa home from vacation.  My wife found this place. Food and service was terrific!! This will now become a regular stop on out travel route planning!!
French onion soup is fantastic! Great menu, but the food was okay.  It was busy brunch time so maybe that was the reason it was just okay.
Fish tacos are very delicious!!

We truely enjoyed our first meal at Sedona Taphouse. Food was outstanding. Service was very good considering the crowd. It was quiet enough to converse with friends. The menu has many options to explore for our next visit.
Really good burger. Big tap beer selection 👌!
My first visit here. We started with the bread basket - delicious! I ordered the salmon and my son had the chicken Caesar salad. All delicious.

Second time getting to eat here, and can’t wait to make it back in! Phoenix did an awesome job (especially for it being only their 3rd day), and was truly so kind. The service was excellent tonight, and the food was impressive (try the Prime Rib sandwich if you get the chance). Everyone here really deserves a raise! Love to see people really care 👌🏻

Great food, good service, reasonable prices.  Waitress was helpful.  We had steaks, crab cakes, and burgers.  All cooked as ordered.  A bit noisy, but we arrived during happy hour.  Will definitely return.
Diverse menu of delicious foods. Comfortable atmosphere for casual dining or date night. Great service.
Knowledgeable staff about gluten free items and Items were marked on menu. food was great. I had the fried calamari and the shrimp appetizer.
All of our food was perfect and they accomodate for food allergies. 10/10 I got chicken alfredo and even the mushrooms were extra good somehow.
Great food.  Good prices.  Try the hummus.   Delicious!

Conveniently located and easy to get to, this place checks all the right boxes. The food is fantastic — fresh, flavorful, and consistently well done. But the real standout? Their happy hour. Incredible deals that make a great experience even better. Whether you’re stopping in after work or meeting up with friends, Sedona Tap House delivers every time. Highly recommend!
I love it 🫶🏼🤩
So good, this was the best burger I had in a while. We also had sliders that was good too.

The food here is great. I have gone 3x so far.
Sometimes the service is hit or miss. The food is always fast and delicious 🤤.
Phillip is the best server there always on point with everything !

We had such an amazing time there as a family of 6!.  Maddie was absolutely amazing.  If you have young children, I highly suggest you ask for her!! She was like having a thirst parent in the best way possible!!! The food came out surprisingly fast. The bartender made an expertly crafted table side cocktail! And you top it off, the manager checked over on more than one occasion. The hostess was warm and accommodating and you could tell the staff actually enjoyed being there. We will 100 percent be making our way back to this location.  It was our first time here after moving to the area and I can't picture a better experience. If you're in the area, I highly recommend giving them a go! They also had a lovely patio area.
Hannah was awesome. Food was excellent.
I wasnt completely in love with the pasta, but my friends that got burgers loved it!
Outstanding staff, excellent atmosphere and great food
The steak friets was excellent as well as the flat bread. The server was slammed so service was marginal. The music was way too load even after it was turned down at my request.
Good food.  Little loud to hold a long conversation.  Good place for large groups.

Food was excellent. If you are going to charge for a bread basket that is the way to do it. Amazing. Chicken and shrimp perfectly cooked. Service was meh. Our server was also the bartended and never checked on food once it was dropped. My drink frequently sat empty (so much so that other servers filled it with pity). I was ready to cash out and get the check and my card sat on the table for over 10 minutes with our dishes done.
Very pleasant restaurant, good selection of food choices on the menu. The hamburger was great! Nice selection of craft beers and local wines.

Great place! We ate here for lunch two days in a row while attending a UVA graduation. The food and drinks were awesome, along with the atmosphere. Our servers were excellent and on the ball with our drinks for a table of 7. I absolutely recommend stopping in for a meal and some drinks.
It was my first time at Sedona and it was excellent. I mean the customer service, food and even the bathroom were spotless.
Very nice place, food well prepared and taste good.
Went there on Mother's Day. It was busy but the service and food were very good.  Didn't have to wait long even though the place was full.  I had the shrimp and grits and I would have it again.
Great Taphouse convenient to the University of Virginia. Interesting menu with great food. Many beers available from the US and the world. Good wine list! Indoor and patio options for dining.
Top notch! We had such a great experience.  Our waitress was so sweet and the food was cooked to perfection!
Great food, great place, great service. Very comfortable. Will be back.

Sat at the bar for 15 minutes and never got service. The staff seemed more focused on talking among themselves than paying attention to customers. With dirty dishes next to me, they may have assumed I had already been served instead of checking if I was waiting to order. No one acknowledged me or offered a menu, so I left, and I’m pretty sure no one even noticed.

Disappointing experience, especially since Sonoma Tap House locations around Richmond are usually quick and attentive.

I’m from the west coast in Oregon and all I ever order is the shrimp and grits. When I visited this restaurant and saw the menu I was excited to try the shrimp and grits and I about fell sour of my chair! It was the Best I have ever had!! Every one in my group loved all of their meals. This place is worth the flight back to eat here again!
Alpine Burger is the best! I updated the “Specials” menu, too!

Came from west side of the country. Had surf/turf and salad. Food was excellent with fresh ingredients. Clam chowder w/bacon was to die for. Beer selection outstanding as was the friendly service. Mgr Troy attentive and cares a lot about the detail. My husband and I cannot recommend it highly enough.

I was in town for a concert so this place was slammed busy. There was about a 45 minute wait but it was within walking distance to the arena and it went by quick enough. Even with every table full our waitress did a fine job keeping up and I really am impressed with the kitchen. We waited outside longer than it took for our entire meal to be ordered and served. Food was hot and tasty and dessert was delicious too. I'd come here again, for sure.

Did Sunday brunch with my college daughter. Big selection and many gluten free options! The truffle fries were delicious. I ordered French onion soup to start. It was too thick and rich (probably because there were so many onions!). It was too "gelatine" and sweet for my liking but it might appeal to others.
For entre, the ahi tuna salad was spot on. My daughter ordered the Ceasars with steak. She said it was great.

Tip: try the truffle fries.

My fiancé and I made our first visit to Sedona this evening 4/18.
1st. It was absolutely slammed.
2nd. We were sat in 30 minutes with no reservation.
3rd. Kevin was our server. IMMACULATE SERVICE. Hands down one of the best servers we have ever had. Calm, professional, intentional.
4th. We had the Bread Basket to start. Had the Kobe Sliders and Hangover Burger. Both spot on.
5th. The White Ferrari Hazy IPA is the Truth.
Highly recommended.
Great food, loaded with beers. We had beef sliders, the Italian flatbread and the best bruscheta we've ever had!
Maddie was the best and made our experience spectacular!!

Wonderful experience! Our server was delightful and attentive! The food was also quite good. We had the vegetable primavera, the hangover hamburger, and two kid steaks. The kid portions were perfect! Very glad we stumbled upon this place!
Good food and huge beer selection
Service and food was delicious.  The Ahi tuna app. Special was the perfect size for lunch!

It was SO good. The food was amazing, but our favorite part was our waitress whose name I really wish I had gotten. I was there with my son after a frustrating and failed attempt to find parking at the Luke Combs concert (worst seriously worst concert experience ever thank you Charlottesville). We were aggravated and annoyed when we got there, but Sedona Taphouse redeemed our evening. Our waitress was so much fun, so nice and really just an absolute pleasure. Then of course the food could not have been ANY better. The beer selection was incredible!!! There was nothing about our time there that I was like hmm maybe this could've been better. Well exceeded expectations and totally redeemed our miserable evening!

Sedona Taphouse was amazing! The food was so good! We had the hummus for an appetizer. My daughter ordered the Devils Pass pasta and I ordered the crab cakes. I also had a flight of beers. Everything was so, so good! Our waitress Tiffany was wonderful. She really made our experience there so comfortable and inviting.  Thanks to all staff for a great dinner out!
Great burgers, steak salad yum...oh and THE best dirty martinis ever!!

First time diners. My family and I really enjoyed this restaurant. The food taste and selections were outstanding, particularly the gluten-free choices. The service was great and we enjoyed sitting out on the patio with our three dogs.  Highly recommend.

Went for an early dinner after heavy duty shoe shopping. My wife and I had a fantastic meal at Sedona Taphouse! Server Kevin was very attentive and professional. The bruschetta with warm goat cheese and sun-dried tomatoes was a nice appetizer, the New Orleans style spicy andouille sausage on papadelle pasta was delicious! Top shelf soup to nuts! Go to Sedona Taphouse (behind the Barracks Road Shops on Millmont St, Charlottesville, VA)
Tons of beers. Great food

We went for dinner on a Friday evening, and the restaurant was quite busy.

The atmosphere is well-suited for slightly more formal family gatherings or casual business dinners. The service was warm and attentive, making the whole experience very comfortable.

We ordered the Smoked Old Fashioned and the Sedona Red Sangria. Both were solid choices and didn’t disappoint.

Truffle Fries: $8.90 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The truffle flavor was rich, and the fries were cooked perfectly, crispy on the outside and very satisfying.

Classic Hummus: $9.90 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The hummus was smooth and creamy. Paired with the soft, warm flatbread, it was very flavorful and enjoyable.

Crab-Stuffed Shrimp with Garlic Whipped Potatoes & Spinach: $24.90 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️❌
A reliable dish overall. The shrimp were large, and you could actually taste chunks of crab inside. The sauce was rich and creamy.

Sedona House Salad: $5.90 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Fresh and refreshing.

Overall, a very pleasant dining experience with good food and great service.

Went for my birthday, sat at the bar. I’ve been a server for years, and have worked in kitchens. Bartender rarely checked on me, let alone other guests. I only wanted to come here because I used to live in Fredericksburg and frequented that location. Which - btw is a lot bigger, friendly and more of a great vibe. I missed my hometown and came here, full of regret. Happy birthday to me.
Had amazing service at Sedona! Madison took care of our family and was super friendly!
Great beer and happy hour deals
Great food! Atmosphere was pleasant. Good service.
Terrible experience. Manager needs customer service training asap.

I went here for a birthday party and the food was delicious, if I could give 6 stars I would. I recommend the Chicken Alfredo, it is delicious and you can tell that it is made from scratch. Would definitely be coming here again in the near future.
Flat beers, nasty food!

Great food.  Steak fritas were perfectly medium rare and well seasoned.  Fries were good.  It was a little loud on a Thursday night, but conversation among our crowd of six was still reasonably doable.  Wife says the shrimp and grits were also good.

First time visitors on our way to event at John Paul Jones Arena.  Great food and service.  Gabriel did a nice job making us feel welcome. The seafood entrees were fresh and delicious. They had excellent wine choices and the appetizers were eclectic.  Dessert and coffee was a nice way to top off the evening.  Everything was perfect.

Had dinner at this location multiple times while staying in Charlottesville. The menu is very diverse and the service is fast. The portions are a regular size so if you’re hungry get an appetizer. It can get pretty packed but definitely worth it. Everything I had including dessert was always good. The owner of the restaurant only does military discount on the service members food instead of the whole table unlike other locations. I didn't mind since my whole party was in the military but it did make for an awkward conversation with our waiter about who would be getting a discount. If you’re in Charlottesville this place is very good and dependable!

Christian was a great server, very personable, very knowledgeable about the menu and the area. Watched him patiently wait on a table of "Spanish speaking only" ladies there celebrating and attempted to use his Spanish skills. Best of luck to Christian in his future endeavors as a doctor!!
Great spot for beer and pub food.
Great place. Friendly and helpful staff. The Manager is always nearby without being intrusive. Highly recommend!!!
Unanimously agreed from everyone at the table that this was the poorest service we have ever received. It was borderline uncomfortable and hostile.

Just as good as the one in Fredericksburg. There was a 15 min wait. It appears they have transformed the waiting area into tables. It was chilly by the window but the food was on point! We started with crab flatbread. It didnt really have the crab meat that I expected but it was good cheese bread. He had the filet which was cooked perfectly. I had steak and stuffed shrimp. Omg both were soooo good. We ended with salted caramel cheesecake with roasted walnuts. Mmm truly memorable experience and cant wait to go back.
Food was delicious but our server was very grumpy and awful.

I’ll be honest, I’m usually a bit skeptical of chain restaurants, but this place quickly proved me wrong. We stopped in on a busy Saturday evening right in Charlottesville and had a great experience from the start.

We grabbed seats at the bar and the service was attentive, fast, knowledgeable, and genuinely friendly. At times the staff did seem a bit scattered, but it never took away from the experience and certainly didn’t reflect poorly on the restaurant. If anything, it felt more like a team moving quickly to keep up with a lively crowd.

The appetizers were excellent, the beer selection from all over the country was impressive, and the food itself was phenomenal. This was a fantastic find, and based on this experience, I wouldn’t hesitate to visit another location. A great spot all around and absolutely worth checking out.
Delicious food and terrific service!
Glad we stopped, I was hungry.

We had great service & food, so this isn’t a negative review about that!

This is because a few days after eating at Sedona I received an email from my bank that I was charged a 50% tip on top of my original transaction. So my original bill with tip went up $20 without my knowledge. After calling the restaurant across two different days, I was told they couldn’t find my card or my transaction despite being able to offer my server’s name, my card number, and the exact time it was charged.

After 15 minutes of being told my transaction didn’t exist and being questioned on if i was giving truthful information, the general manager offered to mail me a $25 gift card. After finding out I lived in the Richmond area (~1 hr away) he said he could only mail to Charlottesville (they have two other locations in the Richmond area). I was left feeling like he didn’t care about my experience, and ended up having to file a dispute with my bank.

Be careful about splitting a bill here and/or ordering the Sunday Meal Deal, as they say the complexities of the transaction is why they lost my information.

They secretly tried to charge me a $40 tip when my meal alone was around 40-50$. I left only 17% when I tipped but I had checked my billing statements later and saw they added extra money into my bill. I was with 8 people for a birthday dinner and 3 other people said the same thing happened to them where their tip was changed to 50% or higher of the bill. Extremely frustrated and disappointed that this is what this establishment does and will NOT be recommending it to anyone. Luckily I got my money back but don’t know how many others they are scamming. Be aware.

This is now our go to place when we visit c-ville. Great staff, excellent draft beer selection and the cooks have done a great job preparing our food.
Definitely will be back!

We had an excellent dinner this evening at the Sedona Taphouse. I was there celebrating a birthday with my family. The server was very helpful and help us with our various food and drink selections.

The food was excellent, I had a New York Strip that was cooked perfectly. There were several other meals chosen from Salmon to Filet mignon from the menu and they were all excellent.

I highly recommend this the restaurant for all occasions.
Delicious! Plenty of Gluten free and healthy options for the family !
Excellent prime rib sandwich...and mashed potatoes....
Great atmosphere and amazing service! Enjoyed the food and drinks; I had lots to choose from as a vegetarian. (My husband had the NY strip steak and said it was also excellent.)
Super slow! Our drinks took 20 minutes to get out!!

Great food and environment!
Buffalo cauliflower, burgers, and crab stuffed shrimp were fantastic

What a dreadful, expensive, and unsatisfying experience . . . All in less than 20 minutes. The server seemed intent on turning the table in record time. The $24 special fish weighed in a five ounces of less.
I blew nearly $100 for a blur of bluster and poor food.
Many gluten free options and everything was delicious! Food came out very quickly as well
Fantastic! Wonderful food and environment

Almost the entire menu can be made gluten free! Even gluten free fired oysters and fried chicken! Amazing!

This review was made in connection with a Toast promotion.

We come here every time we are In town and it never disappoints. We got lunch last week before the game. Great pricing, extensive beer menu, friendly staff. Really cute outdoor area as well if it was warmer

My husband and I had a great experience eating at STH yesterday. Our food and drinks were absolutely delicious and every staff member we encountered was super friendly and welcoming. We were a bit nervous to eat out because we had our baby with us but the experience couldn't have gone better. Special shoutout to our server Rocky who was very attentive  to us and gave us great food recommendations. We will definitely eat here again.
Love this place! The food is expertly prepared and delicious! The bar is excellent. Wait staff is knowledgeable, friendly and efficient. Great atmosphere!
Cockroaches next to my food. Owner tried to argue it’s not a big deal. Should have closed down restaurant until he addressed this problem.

I particularly enjoyed the salads and the sides. The beet salad is very popular and for good reason. The sweet potato fries were very good.  The side greens were great. Asparagus portion was kind of small.  We sat outside and our server disappeared. Less than stellar service is mainly the reason for the minus one star.

My wife and I came in the night of 11/25 for some dinner. The service was just okay but the food was pretty amazing. The atmosphere was solid as well. My main complaint comes at the very end of our experience. As we were paying for the bill, there were 2 roaches climbing around on the wall right next to our table that we were eating on. As you can imagine, it ruined the entire experience after seeing that.  I waited tables at a restaurant for several years so I get it’s impossible to completely eradicate them, but to see multiple at one time is a bigger issue that needs to be addressed.

Noisy, casual restaurant with good food and an extremely varied beer menu. We were just passing through Charlottesville but the place seemed to have a lot of regulars. Our dishes were from the wood grill and very good.
I stopped in to pick up a Gift card for a friend.

All of the food is really great. The goat cheese and tomato jam bruschetta was fantastic. The French Quarter pasta was delicious. Took a while for the server to come by, but once they did, the service was decent. Only bad thing was the table, we were seated at some weird half table booth near the end of the bar. Asked to be moved but said they couldn’t despite three open tables. The two booths behind us only had couples in them so that shouldn’t have been the problem. Overall, the food makes this place worth a visit.
Great beer and appetizer choices

Great place 😎 Came by twice. Good food & service. The Chef Mr Wayne /Owner you can tell he Loves what he does & the customers that visit. He came around & spoke to the many customers at the restaurant. I can tell his staff appreciates him ♥️. I had a great conversation with him . Genuine person you can tell in the food he makes in the restaurant. Thank you God Bless ❤️
PS the best wings I have ever had . A wonderful dry rub with a little heat & a hint of sweetness. Boy oh boy The Best Chef ❤️.
Absolutely delicious!
Excellent food.  Great drinks and attentive service!  We'll be back.
Great beer list, food was good but the steak and burger was not cooked as ordered.

The wings were great, but Mackenzie was the true rock star at STH during my Nov 3, 2025 visit.
I was initially seated and did not receive any service for about 10 minutes. She came over from the bar and presented herself with the most positive attitude I could have ever asked for.
Wings were as good as I expected, and she constantly checked in on me.

A plainly average American restaurant in Charlottesville, VA. The food, service, and atmosphere were all mediocre. I had the sirloin steak and it was cooked well, but the overall portions were very small for the price point. The pumpkin beer was pretty nice though. Overall, an ok experience. Cheers.

Always a fine dining experience at Sedona Taphouse. The food is consistently excellent, and the staff goes above and beyond to make sure everything is perfect. They’re amazing with my wife’s food allergies and always make us feel taken care of. One of our favorite spots to eat out.

We live 2 and half hours away. I googled a place to eat in Charlottesville,  Sedona Tap House is what we chose , let me say. Our server Kevin was at our table in no time. He got our drinks , Then our order. This place was full , I got the crab cakes , and husband got salmon,  I never finish a meal. But the food was delicious,  the sides were great. Prices are very reasonable,  But the food and service were fantastic,  Look it up when your that way. Its worth the stop. Thank you Sedona Tap House.
Our server, Madyson was amazing!  The food was delicious and tasted very fresh!  I highly recommend visiting!
Overall a good experience. Might have been a bit short staffed. Many empty tables but still took time to get food and the check.

Loved it. Lovely outdoor patio with fire pit. Great for a lunch on a nice Fall day. Our server was wonderful with suggestions for best drinks to go with the food. Huge draft beer selection. I loved the St George's Porter.

Had the sliders, 2 beers, and some fries. The "wagyu" sliders were super dry, and tasted more like char, than burger. They were much better after dipping in ketchup. If they were wagyu, it was impossible to tell. The best part of the sliders, was the bun. The fries, barely made the cut, to be labeled fries. Overall, the food was edible, but definitely not worth the price. Though, i do intend on going back, to try the fish, and maybr a few other entrees. All this being said, the bartenders and servers were all very attentive, and somewhat engaging (even during a crazy event). I would go back, but probably not order the sliders.

This is a place I often visit, but since around August or September, the taste and quality have been severely inconsistent. Especially the steak—it’s either burnt black or still bloody and undercooked. I’m not sure if the chef has been replaced or if the kitchen is just too busy, but I’m leaving a negative review. Please do not prioritize profits blindly while neglecting your customers' experience.
Great food, excellent service and such a great atmosphere. Drinks are amazing!!!!

Ordered the basic cheeseburger with fries. Waitress asked "pink or no pink." I told her I didn't want it raw but neither did I want it well done. She seemed to understand. The order came out REALLY quickly - too quickly really. Seemed to me it must have been pre-cooked. It was dried out and well done. The fries seemed to be the common frozen variety.
All in all it was a pretty disappointing lunch. I've been here a few times now and.have yet to get a decent meal. I doubt I'll be back.
Best Burger ever!
The food at Sedona always exceeds expectations. They do a great job of creating consistent quality.

We have eaten at other Sedona restaurants but this was our first time here.  The food was good and on par with other locations.  However, service was very slow and inattentive as the restaurant was not that busy.  Other locations have rated better.
Good food, good drinks friendly but inattentive service.

STH offers a dependable menu of steaks, sandwiches, salads, and burgers. We recently went hoping for brunch, but since it’s not offered on Saturdays, we ordered from the lunch menu (the strawberry beet salad looked especially tempting). The dessert list sticks with classics like apple tart, brownie sundae, and cheesecake; we tried the chocolate cake, which was satisfying. Overall, this is a good choice for anyone who wants familiar, well-prepared American standards.

Went here for dinner on a Saturday night, there was a little bit of a wait but worth it. It I frequently dine out with my friends, but I eat vegan, which can make eating at some places feel like a compromise. This place did have some very easy vegan choices. It's nice that they have that and other dietary options clearly labeled on their menu, so I didn't have to ask the server a ton of questions or guess. I'm not from the area, but if I were back in town I would definitely come again.

Shrimp and grits with a fried egg as suggested by our awesome server Gabe.
Best meal I've eaten in a restaurant in many meals

I return on a regular basis.
Location is plus

I ordered the STH burger to-go/for pick-up and it was fantastic. The picante aioli and the sweet chili glaze are delicious on their own, but together? Oh man. I even re-heated to finish it the next day and it was just as good as the night before. Would and will order again next time I’m in the area.
Gluten free options
Stumbled to this place because it was close to where I was shopping and what a great restaurant, food was exceptional pricing was great and the service was amazing, will definitely go back soon.
An extensive menu of good food served by a great staff, in a charming atmosphere.
It was crowded and loud. Hard to have a conversation with your dinner party.

Tried brunch at Sedona Taphouse and it was pretty good. The T2T Lemon Basil Martini was fresh and easy to drink, nothing too heavy. The Bloody Mary bar was fun — you can mix it up however you like, which makes it a good brunch drink. Overall, a nice spot if you’re looking for something simple with decent options.

Every time I visit Sedona Taphouse, I leave full, happy, and already thinking about my next trip back. The southwestern wings are a must — smoky, flavorful, and perfectly spicy. And if you're hungry, do yourself a favor and get the glazed pork chop with mashed potatoes. It's massive, cooked to perfection, and the glaze adds just the right touch of sweetness.

Our waitress was super polite and genuinely friendly, which made the experience even better. The service here is consistently great, and it’s clear the staff actually care. The draft and cocktail menu is extensive — whether you're into local craft brews or creative cocktails, you’ll find something worth sipping.

Portions are generous, prices are fair, and the food quality never disappoints. I come back whenever I can, and I always leave satisfied.
totally satisfied, from start to finish!!

Jarod was the best!  Ordered salmon and swordfish with the home made salsa topping along with the gorgonzala salad.  Super yummy!  And sitting outside with a beautiful fall/summer breeze really topped off the experience!  Reasonable prices!
The best tasting food!  Friendly environment and excellent service!  I highly recommend this place.

Love this place; awesome selection of beer, good food, and really nice people. And the weather was beautiful, so they had the large door raised, which really added to the atmosphere as we were sitting at the bar.
Food was delicious, staff was wonderful, restaurant is pretty nice, has an outdoor patio with a firepit. Recommend 5/5.
Nice selection of food and beverages in either an indoor or outdoor setting. Very pleasant staff.

Service was great ($$). Unfortunately, we didn’t think the food was food was worth the price. The meals were mediocre, with ratings between 3 and 4 out of 10. The wings were disappointing. The steak on the salad and tacos tasted preprepared, and the "grill marks" looked artificial, like processed "steakette" or "ribette" products.
Did not disappoint! Food was delicious. Nice and busy, plan for a wait!
Food was good, and fairly priced. It was very busy, so service was a little slow.
A little loud but excellent food!
Nice place. Large portions and good service.
Good place with tons of beer offerings. The fried cauliflower was delish as was the pasta.

Overall waste of money and subpar, unskilled kitchen staff despite the high price.
Wings had both overdone and wet and unseasoned pieces. Celery on the side had gross oxidized brown edges and had clearly been floated in water for ages as it was floppy and soaked half the plate the wings were on.
Brussel sprouts are a two dollar upcharge for some reason, but they came as just a bland unseasoned boiled pile. "Grilled' asparagus also had zero char and was not trimmed properly, tons of woody ends on the overcooked mushy spears.
One of the sides were also wrong and we had to wait for it be reprepared.
The hostess was kind as was our server, but I also find it crazy I ordered a beer at a taphouse and after our food came out, no one came to ask about refills.
The restaurant was not busy but there were so many people on the floor, literally a different person brought every part of our meal, including the mess up that had to be reordered.
Overall a really disappointing experience with the very obvious feeling nobody in back of house cares about anything they're putting out. We will not be back to this location.
The food was good the service was good but the general manager was not customer friendly. He was pretty rude on two different times to our group of 9. He could use a class on customer service.

Visiting Charlottesville area and happened upon Sedona Taphouse. We hit the jackpot!  Plenty of available  parking. We were warmly welcomed and seated within minutes. They have an extensive menu, and portions are large. A great selection of beers and cocktails to choose from.  Food is absolutely delicious. Many of the patrons around us were also commenting positively about their respective entree selections. Service was 5-star; attentive, friendly and genuinely caring. Highly recommend a visit for a sumptuous dining experience.
The dish had crab stuffed in shrimp. It was excellent. My favorite dish not shrimp is the Devils Pass Pasta. It slightly spicy but perfect in flavor. The service was excellent.
The best

I came here with my mom, we both tried the chicken and the steak tacos- they were excellent!!!
I highly recommend the steaks.
Also this place is a tap house so they have an incredible wine and beer selection bigger than the food menu, lots of beer on draft. Need to bring my husband back to try the steak and beer for sure!!
The hostess was very friendly the waiter was very friendly and informative and the manager even walk by and asked how we were. Great atmosphere of the place was clean and the food was great highly recommend this place.
Great food and drinks and we love the atmosphere.
Incredible gluten free options (bread, pasta, flatbread, tortillas, dessert). We loved both the food and drinks, and the service was excellent. Will be back!

Fix the ripped pleather seats in the booths ! Do not have jalapeño poppers on your menu unless you can cook them correctly.. they were horrible!!!
Updated review ; 8.3.2025
Food is sub par & overpriced & drinks are also overpriced . Unfortunately; Don’t think I’ll be back . Service is good , tho I don’t like anyone standing over me waiting to see what tip I’m going to leave on the hand held machine ? Unprofessional.

We were traveling through Charlottesville and spent a night. We were looking for something other than fast food and found Sedona Taphouse online. We are soo happy we did. My husband loved the beer and I had a great espresso martini. We had the Spicy Thai Shrimp app and it was perfectly cooked and delicious. I had the Chuckawalla Chicken and my husband had the STH Burger, both exceeded our expectations. So good. Our server was Annie U. and she could not have been more helpful or courteous. She is a rising musical Theater star, so go while she's still there. Although, I am sure the rest of the staff great too.

We were a very large family group of 35 that had reserved the private area at the back near the kitchen. We were given a limited but varied menu to order from which took into account our dietary restrictions and preferences.  We received excellent service. Favorites included the burgers and the Primavera either with chicken or shrimp added. The food was very good. One person in our party wasn’t completely happy with his salmon.

STH hosted 26 of us for a dinner during our family reunion gathering in Charlottesville July 24, 2025.  The management could not have been any more helpful in the weeks ahead as we determined the number to attend, the time, and the menu.  They allowed us to narrow down the menu to items that would suit the needs of this mostly senior group.  The area we were seated in was set off from the rest of the restaurant so somewhat private.  The service was outstanding.  We were amazed at how organized and quick they were in taking our orders and delivering our meals.  No one had to wait long for a meal.  They dealt well with multiple checks.  We could not have been happier with our experience.  The food was excellent! Everyone enjoyed their meal very much.  We made an excellent choice when we chose Sedona Taphouse!  Thank you!

The food was great and Lilah was a phenomenal server but the AC or lack there of was unacceptable. I walked to the bathroom and the thermostat was 81 degrees?!? I understand it’s hot but even the bathroom was cooler. Not only is this inconvenient and makes guests want to leave as quickly as possible, it’s not safe. As someone with a heart condition I should have been warned of this issue before sitting down to eat as it caused me to have some irritations. A big thank you is in order for all your staff who endures that humid & hot room. Thank you to Lilah & the sweet hostesses for making our experience more bearable.
Wonderful. Every bite of our food was perfect.

Love to visit this restaurant.
Everything is always excellent--food, service, atmosphere.
I shared a wonderful lunch here with an old friend, great Salmon!!! Nice atmosphere and friendly informed service
Good Service, Good Appetizers

Tried Sedona Taphouse while visiting the area. Absolutely can’t say enough good things about this restaurant. My husband and MIL had the scallops and I had the Devils Pass pasta. Everyone’s dishes were amazing! I can’t wait to eat here again!
Great food and great service. I will be back!
The food was outstanding! Delicious appetizers! Great beer selection, too. Loved the atmosphere. Plenty of parking. Clean bathrooms.  Thanks, Annie, for taking care of us!

Met up with some friends here, loved the ambiance.  They had a huge selection of beers.  We were pleased with our beers, ciders and delicious food.  Our waitress Annie was very attentive and friendly.  Nice outside seating.  Clean restrooms, easy accessibility and plenty of parking.
Nice atmosphere, great food, and great service.
Always feel welcome and have a great meal. So many drink options. Dogs allowed on patio. Get a deal on Monday evenings with half price steak.
Great food and atmosphere! The staff is friendly and always make you feel at home
We absolutely loved this place. Service, food, and beer selection 👌 even DELICIOUS NA options. 10/10

Five stars for everything. This is a neighborhood restaurant with plenty of parking. Huge selection of beers on tap and in bottles. The Desert Fire Jalapeños deserve an award. Everything else we ordered (burger, salad, flatbread) were delicious. Highly recommended.
The place is quite loud, there also happened to be a group of men having a party near us. Despite that, it was an enjoyable dinner,  the steak was so tender and flavorful.

Started with goat cheese and tomato jam bruschetta-absolutely delicious. My seared salmon with lemon butter sauce with sides of whipped garlic potatoes and crispy Brussel sprouts was exquisite. The service was excellent.
Very nice
Great atmosphere and unique food choices!
absolutely awful food, steak tasted like metal and super chewy, calimari was beyond fishy. spent 90$ on dog food
Food was great, but the service was lacking.
Stopped in for lunch and had some great crab cake sliders.
This place is awesome!
Great food.  Service was a little lacking, drinks were empty more than gold
Hard to say what was better - the scallops, lemon cake, or the service.  My only complaint is that it's a little loud.
